content: Riya Mukherjee inquired about the higher health policy renewal premium, which Vikram Singh explained was due to medical inflation and requested maternity coverage. Vikram provided a detailed cost breakdown totaling $8,200 per annum and outlined monthly, quarterly, and annual payment options. Riya requested a day to consider the options and asked about the acceptance deadline, which Vikram noted is October 15, 2026.

action_items: Riya to consider the renewal quote and payment options
Riya to provide acceptance or follow up by October 15, 2026
